content:
**Abandoned Mine Shaft Elaine** is a location in the Ash Heap region of Appalachia.

This mine was owned by Hornwright Industrial prior to the Great War, using its Auto-Miners to gather resources. [1] 

A rail track runs into the mouth of the mine shaft. The mine itself has collapsed at the entrance and can only be entered during the Event: Lode Baring. Both sides of the entrance have Claim Token Exchange Terminals, to redeem claim tokens gained during the event.

To the east of the rails is a raised platform with a blue pod on it, the interior of which has a few containers. Two staircases to the east and north bring the player character to a second raised platform. A smaller blue pod can be found to the north with various foodstuffs to loot. The easternmost metal building houses a row of lockers in the center and a few other containers spaced around. The exterior eastern wall has a Power Armor Station with a possible Power Armor Chassis spawn.

Power Armor Chassis with T-series armor pieces - Outside with a power armor station, between the locker room building and a bus.

Abandoned Mine Shaft Elaine appears in *Fallout 76*.
